items.description:
Tired of chasing after bosses or want to know if they're near? Then look no further.

[h1]What this mod does[/h1]
This mod adds a player-like indicator to bosses to know if they're lurking around, so that you can go and smack them in their face - or run away from them before they get too close.

This indicator can display bosses up to 3 - 4 screens away, their distance being related to the size of their icon (larger icon = closer).

Currently the following bosses are tracked:[list]
[*]Deerclops
[*]Dragonfly
[*]Bearger
[*]Moose/goose
[*]Antlion
[*]Ancient Guardian
[*]Toadstool (both cap and actual boss)
[*]Klaus
[*]Loot Stash[/list]

If you find a bug, have a suggestion or just like this mod, feel free to leave a comment.

items.description:
[h1]Brief Introduction[/h1]
Addition of the Medal System, you can use the cartographer's desk to make various medals.

Functional Medal is an extended mod with the theme of "growth". It adds a new type of prop "medal" on the basis of the original game.
Different medals represent different abilities. Some medals can let you have the abilities of other roles, some medals can greatly improve your work efficiency, and some medals can bring you the power to turn the world around. Although the ability brought by the medal is strong, it is not easy to obtain. You need to experience all kinds of adventures in the eternal continent and taste the ups and downs of island survival before you can get the growth you deserve.
In addition, there are more extended content you have never seen before~

[h1]Mod Document[/h1]
Due to the limited space and for the convenience of maintenance, I have made a more detailed mod introduction page for this mod. For those who need to view the introduction of props in mod and update the log, please visit the following link~
[url=https://www.guanziheng.com/]Introduction page of Functional Medal[/url]

items.name: 牛状态标BeefaloStatusBar
items.title: Beefalo Status Bar
items.description:
[h1]Beefalo Status Bar[/h1]
It shows up when you mount a beefalo, goes away when you dismount. You can also toggle it on or off (when mounted) if you feel like it's getting in your way.
Note that toggling will override the "Show Automatically" setting for the current shard session (going in and out of the caves or reloading will reset it to whatever it was originally set to).


[h1]Information[/h1]
Most everything should be pretty straight forward, except maybe the tendency and the hunger badge, so let me explain.

[h1]Domestication and Tendency:[/h1]
The color of the domestication badge will reflect the current tendency of your beefalo. This is configurable, but by default it goes like this:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/bHMl3Sb.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/877HBr0.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/Mk7X39h.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/LtxSAfE.png ]

There are 13 colors (8 unique and 5 variations) to choose from.

Note: Last I checked, the only time the game tries to make your beefalo domesticated is when you feed it. This means that when you reach 100% domestication your beefalo won't become domesticated until you feed it something.

[h1]Ride Timer:[/h1]
This badge shows how much time you have left riding your beefalo before it bucks you off. Hovering over it will show you how many uses your saddle has left.
[b]Note[/b]: Your saddle will [b]NOT[/b] lose durability when the timer runs out. The only time this happens is when the beefalo shakes it off it's back.

[h1]Hunger Badge:[/h1]
Your beefalo needs to have at least 15 hunger (configurable) at mount time to activate the hunger badge. Once activated, when the beefalo's hunger reaches 0 it will deactivate itself again.
This should be low enough to easily trigger it while still in the process of domestication, but high enough to almost never see it once your beefalo is fully domesticated.


[h1]F.A.Q.[/h1]
[b]I don't see the numbers below the badges, why?[/b]
- They are a feature of another mod called [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url][/b]. In order to see them you will need to download/subscribe to it (and enable it). [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Click here[/url] to do just that.

[b]Can you make this a client only mod?[/b]
- No. Unfortunately, the beefalo information is not available on the client, so a client only version is not possible.

[b]I'm using a HUD reskin mod, how do I make this mod use the reskinned badges?[/b]
- Set the "Theme" option to "Default Theme".


[h1]Latest Changelog:[/h1]
[h1]v1.4.0[/h1]
[h1]General[/h1]
- Added support for resetting the ride timer by raising obedience when mounted.
- Added Beige color (or close to it) as a color choice for all badges.
- Changed the default domestication badge color for "Default" beefalo from White to Beige.
- Increased the default hunger badge threshold from 10 to 15.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue causing the Status Bar to move up a little bit each time the player changes characters when using The Forge theme without Combined Status.

[h3]Other:[/h3]
- A small backend change for future-proofing that will hopefully not cause any trouble.

[h3]Notes:[/h3]
- In the upcoming game update, beefalo can be fed while mounted. This will increase their obedience (unless already maxed out), which will reset the ride timer. In case other scenarios where obedience is raised while riding are to be added in the future (like brushing for example), they should be properly accounted for as well.
- Due to how mod configurations work in the game, if you already have a saved configuration the new defaults may not be properly reflected until you reset or change them manually.

Woddie and Lucy rate this 5 stars.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Q&A[/h1]

[h1]How Can I Upgrade?[/h1]
1. Put at least 1 upgrade material in all the outermost slots.
2. Close the container.

Degrade:
1. Clear your chest
2. Put 1 hammer into the chest
3. Close the container
4. It will consume 5 uses, trade for half of the upgrading material


[h1]How Large Can The Chest Be?[/h1]
Here is few options allow you to choose how many times it could update. How large? Check the last option! It is infinite!
[spoiler]in fact not but you may never reach the upper limit[spoiler]even you hit the limit, I can easily top up the limit. wanna give it a try?[/spoiler][/spoiler]


[h1]Do The Mod Break The Balance?[/h1]
Certainly not.
A normal chest has 9 slots and cost 3 boards. i.e. 3 slots for each boards

With this mod,
The 5x5 chest cost a total 11 boards with a total 25 slots, i.e. 25 / 11 = 2.2 slots per boards.
The 7x7 chest cost a total 27 boards with a total 49 slots, i.e. 49 / 27 = 1.8 slots per boards.

That means for each upgrade, you have to trade more boards for less slots.


[h1]Why there is no option under UI setting? [/h1]
It is not able to adjust UI setting in worldgen menu. You must visit mod screen in main menu for setting.
ie. Main Menu → Mods → Server Mods → Upgradable Chest

I hope UI setting could could be set by each client. All client should follow the setting from server host if I do not make it a client option. For example, if the server host turn the "Ice Box Leftward", all clients are forced on even they don't want to. items.name: 全图定位(完全同步)
items.title: Global Positions (CompleteSync)
items.description:
[h2] Main feature [/h2]
Just like the original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positioning[/url], it allows players to share exploration maps and mark signals on the map. However when using original mod, the maps between players are not completely synchronized, for example:
1. The player just joined the game, and the other players on the map have explored many places, but the newly added player cannot see the places explored by other players before he joined.
2. Player A is on the ground, and player B goes to the cave to explore. When player A enters the cave, he cannot see the place explored by player B before he enters the cave.
3. The player read the message in the bottle of the Crabby Hermit, and other players will not update the map like player A.
This mod solves these problems and can achieve complete synchronization. See the videos for a demonstration.

[h2]Bugs fixed：[/h2]
1. Fix the far away point of interest bug in the original mod.
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2425844467144089786/684C53427208270FBCB431A1E0ED9042045348A4/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
2. The bug in the original mod that caused the signal marker to possibly deviate from the mouse position has been fixed. (In the original mod, if you dragged the map to its extreme position and continued dragging, the map would no longer move with the mouse. After that, the signal marker would deviate from the mouse position.)
3. Fixed the longstanding issue of icon misalignment in modules related to global positioning. Sometimes, the icons on the map would misalign, resulting in "mirages" on the map. For example, users might find that the building icons of their base are copied to another location on the map, or they may encounter strange icons outside the map boundaries. In fact, I believe this is a bug within the game itself, and the Global Position-type mods simply make it more likely to trigger ([url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/klei-bug-tracker/dont-starve-together/a-long-standing-bug-in-the-maprevealer-which-causes-map-icons-to-be-misaligned-r46911/]Bug report[/url]).
(Update: Klei has claimed to have fixed the bug I reported. It's very likely that this issue has also been resolved in other global positioning mods.)
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2425844467144080073/2844A976983D26F443E1087CF68152156035589F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/43440899924063808/7F394F1C087EB999B30E6A27C28C488B30DFB27F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
4. Fixed the issue where the Beefalo icons would leave ghosting effects when their owner moving too quickly. In fact, this is a bug in the game itself, which I reported on the forum ([url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/klei-bug-tracker/dont-starve-together/domesticated-beefalo-still-produce-map-icon-trails-r46296/?tab=comments#comment-66665]link[/url]). This mod will display the beefalo_bell icon instead of the beefalo. You can disable this option in the settings under "Remove Ghost Icons".

[h2]Other functions:[/h2]
1. Now Walter can deliver items to teammates without using a compass. This feature can also be disabled in the options. Thanks to @Kerr for providing the coding idea.
2. Map areas revealed by the Zaptrocuter are now visible to all players, alongside a new option that allows the flying Portable Storage Unit's icon to be seen by everyone.
3. Added acceleration options to help reduce server CPU usage. All of these options are disabled by default. Among them, “Quick Map share” is expected to be quite effective and can be enabled if needed. Many thanks to @暮色黯然 and hisfriends for their enthusiastic testing.
There are also options for “Disable fogrevealer” and “Remove maprevealer tag,” which might help reduce CPU consumption, though I’m not certain. These two options can cause other side effects, so it is recommended to leave them disabled. Enabling “Disable fogrevealer” will remove the circular bright area around teammates' icons, and will also prevent Wortox from jumping directly onto a teammate’s boat. Enabling “Remove maprevealer tag” will cause map icon updates around players to no longer synchronize. For example, if Player A digs up a tuft of grass, this option may cause Player B’s map to still show the grass icon. If you're interested, feel free to help test whether these two options provide a significant performance improvement—your feedback would be greatly appreciated.


======================

Note:
1. The mod is implemented based on the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]. In the previous version, I also used the codes from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2902364746]Global Positions -Remapped[/url] to sync the map. Please subscribe to them as a gesture of support (of course, the normal functioning of my mod doesn't rely on other mods).
2. If there are bugs or other modification suggestions, please give feedback. I sincerely apologize for the recent bugs that have caused map loss. If you still lost the explored map in the newest version, please leave a comment.
3. Known issue: If you switch from the original global positioning to this mod in an old save file, and immediately change characters or save the game, it can cause the loss of map exploration progress in caves. A temporary workaround is to visit the caves once before switching characters or save the game for the first time. I'm still trying to fix this problem. For now, it's best to use this mod in a new save file. Additionally, disabling this mod mid-game may also lead to map loss. If you need to disable this mod for some purposes like resolving mod conflicts, please make sure to back up your save file or record the maps of the cave and the forest into a map scroll. Thank @󰀐超级麦旋风 and @Halo Lemon for testing.
4. You may check the codes in [url=https://github.com/hellohawaii2/Global-Position-CompleteSync]Github[/url]

items.name: 横板技能施法
items.title: Horizontal Skill Casting
items.description:
[h1][b]Horizontal Skill Casting[/b][/h1]
[i]Rewrites character skill wheels into a [b]horizontal layout[/b], with highly customizable [b]hotkey bindings[/b] and [b]instant casting[/b].[/i]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FKn0rY03/SKILL5.gif[/img]

[h2][b]What does this mod do?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Horizontal layout:[/b] Replaces the original radial skill wheel with a horizontal skill bar, positioned above the inventory by default
[*][b]Stays open:[/b] The wheel remains open after using a skill; right-click again or use the closing hotkey to close it
[*][b]Free dragging:[/b] Drag the wheel anywhere with the right mouse button, press the middle mouse button to reset, and save its position automatically
[*][b]Adaptive scaling:[/b] Automatically follows the game's HUD scale setting
[*][b]Hotkeys for every character:[/b] Assign dedicated hotkeys to supported character skills
[*][b]Instant casting:[/b] Cast directly with a hotkey and skip target selection
[*][b]Continuous casting:[/b] Automatically re-enter targeting after casting and support holding a hotkey for repeated casts
[*][b]Cooldown display:[/b] Shows cooldown timers for Willow and Wendy, while skill wheels display skill availability
[/list]

[h1]Supported Characters[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Maxwell[/b] - Shadow spells + [b]Codex refueling[/b] + Top Hat hotkey
[*][b]Wendy[/b] - Abigail commands + [b]Rile/Soothe toggle[/b] + Elixir basket hotkey
[*][b]Willow[/b] - Fire spells + [b]automatic fire attacks[/b] + Fire absorption hotkey + Cooldown timer
[*][b]Walter[/b] - Woby command wheel + [b]dash hotkey[/b] + Double-click dash toggle + Right-click mounting
[*][b]Winona[/b] - [b]Remote command wheel[/b]
[*][b]Wickerbottom[/b] - [b]Horizontal book wheel[/b], with an option to switch back to the original radial wheel
[*][b]Wigfrid[/b] - [b]Instant battle songs[/b] / song switching hotkeys + Lightning spear and shield attacks + Landing marker
[*][b]WX-78[/b] - [b]Shielding Circuit hotkey[/b] + One-click haunting of the nearest backup body
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FRMMyDtp/spell3.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6QmJ3BYD/spell1.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/76JvJjRb/spell2.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nrq60BpJ/spell4.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/KcLSGSLH/spell5.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9FRGVwjT/15.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2][b]Hotkey Bindings[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Custom bindings:[/b] Assign dedicated hotkeys to skills for every supported character
[*][b]Instant casting:[/b] Enable all skills, disable all skills, or configure each skill individually
[*][b]Continuous casting:[/b] Hold a hotkey to cast repeatedly; right-click to cancel targeting
[*][b]Modifier keys:[/b] Selected features support Alt, Ctrl, and Shift modifiers
[*][b]Avoid conflicts:[/b] All hotkeys can be customized to avoid conflicts with other mods
[/list]

[h2][b]Character-Specific Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Willow:[/b] [b]Automatic fire attacks[/b] — automatically equips a lighter when attacking burnable targets, then restores the previous weapon; configurable HP threshold, fire absorption hotkey, and cooldown display
[*][b]Wigfrid:[/b] Three battle songs with [b]instant casting[/b] and switching hotkeys; lightning spear/shield attack hotkey; [b]landing marker[/b] and cooldown status display
[*][b]Walter:[/b] Dash hotkey; [b]double-click dash toggle[/b]; right-click to mount or dismount Woby
[*][b]Maxwell:[/b] [b]Codex refueling hotkey[/b]; shadow spell hotkeys; Top Hat hotkey
[*][b]WX-78:[/b] Shielding Circuit hotkey; one-click [b]haunting[/b] of the nearest backup body
[/list]

[b]All hotkeys can be customized to avoid conflicts with other mods.[/b]
The mod also improves WX-78 right-click module action synchronization when client-side mods add or modify actions such as Sonic or Shielding.

[h1][b]Settings and Usage[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Open [b]Pause Menu → Settings → Controls → Horizontal Casting[/b]
[*]All hotkey and feature options are located at the top of the list
[*]Click [b]Apply[/b] after making changes
[*]After switching wheel styles, reopen the skill wheel to see the new layout
[*]This is a client-side mod; other players usually do not need to install it
[/list]

[h1][b]Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Horizontal layout:[/b] Skills are arranged dynamically according to the skills currently available
[*][b]Hotkey setup:[/b] Configure each character's hotkeys before using them
[*][b]Instant casting:[/b] Works when casting through hotkeys; enable all, disable all, or configure skills individually
[*][b]Continuous casting:[/b] When enabled, manually targeted spells re-enter targeting after casting; right-click cancels targeting
[*][b]Cooldown display:[/b] Willow and Wendy support cooldown timers; other characters mainly display skill availability
[*][b]Willow fire attack HP threshold:[/b] Requires a server-side health display mod to check target HP; otherwise the target is always ignited
[/list]

[h1][b]Too Many Hotkeys?[/b][/h1]
Open [b]Pause Menu → Settings → Controls → Horizontal Casting[/b] to find all hotkey settings.

[hr][/hr]

If you have questions or find a bug, I will try to fix it as soon as possible.
For easier troubleshooting, please provide the [b]crash log[/b], the [b]specific situation that triggered the issue[/b], and a list of your [b]enabled mods[/b].

items.name: 建筑对齐增强StructureAlignmentPro
items.title: Structure Alignment Pro
items.description:
Structure Alignment Plus has undergone a major refactoring for coherence and extensibility and will now be Structure Alignment Pro "[BETA]". More features are planned.

I recommend changing the default Structure Alignment toggle key bind to avoid conflict with quick drop and other mods. I personally bind it to the key to the immediate right of left shift.

Seeking general feedback, more specifically on categories, interfacing, and mod compatibility. I do not have a controller to test with so will need detailed visuals/descriptions of what currently happens vs. what is expected/desired.

[h3]Modified Controls[/h3]
Left-click does not examine while heavy lifting or holding the force attack control.
Right-click actions do not get target blocked. (e.g. can direct plant on tilled soil)
Right-click actions will use target position if force attack control is held. (e.g. star stacking)
Item use actions are not target blocked by containers. (e.g. placing or drawing on Mini Signs does not get target blocked by containers)
Right-clicking with a deployable item in the active item slot to an invalid position does not return it to inventory unless the force attack control is held.
Digging turf or placing to tile will go for less walking distance unless the force attack control is held.
Items can be deployed from inventory when the force attack control is held.

[h3]Features[/h3]
Placement can show the tile outline for a given position.
Placement will use assigned grid sizes based on context.
Grid placers will align to boats when standing on boats unless the force attack control is held.
Items can get a grid placer for dropping. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2431691504]related mod[/url])
Items can be quick dropped to contextual positions.
Mod options can be updated from the pause menu. Grid options can be manually refreshed by entering ClearAxisAlignmentGrids(true) in local console.
Wendy's graves can be placed without a skeleton.

[h3]Crop Placement[/h3]
Integrated positions (cycled with grid cycle control) from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2302837868]Snapping Tills[/url] for tilling and direct planting, including Gorge mod.
Supports all tools and mods that allow for tilling or direct planting.
Snaps to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3276915747]Onboard Gardens[/url].
4x4 will prefer using valid tile closer to the player.
Toggling alignment will give access to grids, where 6x6 can be used to compact loose soil.
If you choose to use mods based on the original Snapping Tills, the built-in features will be inactive and the grid will no longer appear when direct planting seeds.

[h3]Indicators[/h3]
Ignitable objects (tile outline on inspect)

items.name: 造房子
items.title: Build Houses
items.description:
Adds two taller wall types for building houses, giving you an indoor feel and stronger protection.
Wood House Wall / Stone House Wall: Crafted in the Structures tab with the Alchemy Engine.


Features:
- Enclosed areas formed with house walls are treated as rooms. Regular walls and doors can also be used as part of the enclosure. The default room size limit is 800 wall tiles; larger areas will not be recognized as rooms.
- A roof is automatically added when a room is formed. If the enclosure is broken, such as by hammering down a wall, the roof is automatically removed.
- When you enter a room, the walls below the current room and the roofs of all adjacent rooms automatically become transparent to avoid blocking your view. Nearby walls also become transparent while you are placing house walls.
- Natural Shield: The roof can protect you from rain, snow accumulation, wildfire, overheating, sandstorms, moonstorms, meteors, and Antlion sinkholes.
- Creature Shield: Indoor areas block various hasslers and creatures from spawning, such as hounds, Deerclops, Bearger. House walls can resist attacks from external monsters and giants, and can knock back giants.
- Doors can be installed on house walls, just right-click the wall while holding an original door.
- Multiple options to customize, such as power and effects control.

Less ideal features: They do not block flying creatures, and giants' area attacks can still reach the interior.

items.description:
[h1]Simple Health Bar (Reforged)[/h1]

[h2]Introduction[/h2]
A modern DST rebuild and maintained version of the classic mod “Simple Health Bar DST.”

While preserving the original art style and core features, this version rewrites multiplayer synchronization, health bar rendering, and the settings interface, with improved compatibility, stability, and usability for current versions of DST.

This mod must be installed on the server and by all clients.


[h2]Main Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Displays health bars for players, creatures, bosses, walls, and other entities with health
[*]Includes 14 health bar styles, health-based gradients, relationship/hostility colors, and fixed colors
[*]Provides four settings categories: General, World, Player, and Boss
[*]World, Player, and Boss can independently configure style, color, opacity, position, height, length, thickness, and exact health values
[*]Supports Overhead, Overhead with inline values, and Bottom positions
[*]Bar length ranges from 6 to 24, fixed thickness from 10 to 45, with up to 30 downward offset and 50 upward offset
[*]Supports exact health values, floating damage/healing numbers, damage trails, and intro animations
[*]Includes a draggable heart widget, settings menu, and fullscreen style preview
[*]Supports Chinese and English and can automatically follow each player’s DST interface language
[*]Allows the server to restrict exact health values, damage numbers, wall health bars, display distance, and the number of visible bars
[/list]


[h2]How to Use[/h2]
[list]
[*]Press [b]H[/b] by default to open or close the settings menu
[*]Click the floating heart widget to open the settings menu
[*]Drag the heart widget to change its position
[*]Drag the title area at the top of the menu to move the menu
[*]Press [b]F8[/b] by default to open or close the style preview
[*]Client display settings take effect immediately and are saved locally
[/list]


[h2]Category Settings[/h2]
The H menu contains four tabs: General, World, Player, and Boss.

General settings provide the base configuration for all entities. World, Player, and Boss follow General by default, but can independently override style, color, opacity, position, height, length, thickness, exact health values, and value text size.

Category priority is:

[code]Boss > Player > World[/code]

Setting a category’s style to Off only hides its health bar and exact health values. Eligible floating damage and healing numbers remain controlled separately.


[h2]Preview Hotkey[/h2]
[list]
[*]The default preview hotkey is [b]F8[/b]
[*]The preview hotkey can be changed or disabled in the H menu
[*]Changes take effect immediately and are saved on the local client
[*]Select [b]None[/b] to disable the preview hotkey
[*]The fullscreen style preview uses the General length and thickness; category-specific sizes must be viewed on actual entities
[/list]

The following path in the main-menu mod configuration:

[code]Main Menu → Mods → Server Mods → Simple Health Bar (Reforged) → Configure Mod → Preview Hotkey[/code]

is only used to set the initial value. Once the player changes the hotkey in the H menu, the locally saved setting takes priority.


[h2]Language Settings[/h2]
The H menu provides three language modes:

[list]
[*][b]Auto[/b]: Follows the current player’s DST interface language
[*][b]中文[/b]: Always uses Chinese
[*][b]English[/b]: Always uses English
[/list]

In Auto mode, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Rail Chinese clients use Chinese. All other client languages use English.

The “Fallback language” option in the server mod configuration is only used when the client language cannot be detected. It does not override the player’s local selection in the H menu.


[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]This mod only supports [b]Don't Starve Together[/b]
[*]The server and all joining clients must have this mod installed
[*]Some client options may be locked by server policy
[*]World, Player, and Boss settings follow General by default
[*]Very large health bars or text may occupy significant screen space on small entities, near screen edges, or during large battles
[*]Health bar placement may be affected by entity models, camera distance, resolution, and other HUD mods
[*]Language settings saved by older versions will be preserved; select Auto in the H menu to follow the DST interface language
[*]Due to limited free time, responses and fixes may take some time. Thank you for your understanding
[/list]


[h2]Resetting Client Settings[/h2]
To completely reset this mod’s local settings, exit the game first and open:

[code]%USERPROFILE%\Documents\Klei\DoNotStarveTogether\<numeric account directory>\client_save\[/code]

Delete the following file:

[code]simplehealthbar_reforged_client_config_v2[/code]

If the old configuration file is still present, it may also be deleted:

[code]simplehealthbar_reforged_client_config[/code]

Restart the game and the mod will restore its default settings.

Do not delete the entire [code]client_save[/code] folder.


[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]
When reporting an issue, please provide:

[list]
[*]The current mod version
[*]Client, Master, and Caves logs
[*]The affected entity or situation
[*]The category, style, position, length, thickness, and height settings being used
[*]Relevant screenshots and reproduction steps
[*]Whether any camera, view-distance, interface, or HUD mods are also enabled
[/list]


[h2]Copyright Notice[/h2]
This mod is a non-commercial rebuild and maintained version of “Simple Health Bar DST.”

Original mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1207269058]Simple Health Bar DST[/url]

Original author: DYC

Reforged version author: 无处安放的记忆

The original mod’s concept, name lineage, and some art assets belong to DYC and their respective rights holders. This reforged version is intended only to support current versions of DST, fix issues, and improve usability. It is not intended for commercial use.

If the original author or any relevant rights holder does not wish this version to remain published, please contact me and I will remove or adjust the relevant content promptly.

items.name: 综合状态CombinedStatus
items.title: Combined Status
items.description:
[h1]Supports all versions of Don't Starve ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=574636989]Vanilla, Reign of Giants, Shipwrecked, Hamlet[/url], Don't Starve Together).[/h1]

[h2]You can also download from [url=https://github.com/rezecib/Combined-Status/releases]GitHub[/url], although that won't auto-update for you. (code contributions also welcome via GitHub)[/h2]

This mod enhances the HUD to better show the player's stats and various information about the world, such as temperature, season, and moon phase.

This is a client-only mod, so whoever has enabled it will see the changes, and whoever doesn't won't, regardless of what server you're on and whether the server has the mod or not.

Note that unlike Kiopho's Always On Status, I use the game's temperature units directly here, so player temperature can safely vary from 0-70, with freezing/overheating warnings occurring at 5 and 65. (you can change it to C, which works like Kiopho's version, or F if you want)

Credits to Kiopho ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=180843799]Always On Status[/url]), Soilworker ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=298407615]Season Clock[/url]), and hotmatrixx ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=292558919]Better Moon[/url]) for making the original mods. I completely rewrote all of the code to be more compatible, aesthetic, and easily maintained going forward.

[h1]Configuration Options[/h1]

[table]
[tr][td][h1]Option[/h1][/td][td][h1]Description[/h1][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Temperature[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the temperature of the player. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show World Temp[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the temperature of the world. Defaults to [i]Hide[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Temp Badges[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show small images to indicate which temperature is which. Badges only get shown if this is set to [i]Show[/i] and both player and world temperatures are enabled. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Temperature Unit[/h1][/td][td]Whether to use the game's internal units (default), or approximations of Fahrenheit or Celsius.
[list][*] In [i]Game Units[/i], the player freezes at 0 and overheats at 70, with warning occurring 5 away.
[*] In [i]Celsius[/i], the player freezes at 0 and overheats at 35, with warning occurring 2.5 degrees away.
[*] In [i]Fahrenheit[/i], the player freezes at 32 and overheats at 95, with warning occurring 4.5 degrees away.
[/list][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Waning[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show if the moon is waxing or waning by adding new icons. Defaults to [i]Show[/i]. (The game normally only shows icons for one direction). In Don't Starve Together, this is now a feature of the main game, so the option doesn't do anything.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Moon[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the moon only at [i]Night[/i] (the game's default), during night and dusk ([i]Dusk[/i], the mod's default), or [i]Always[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Predict Full Moon[/h1][/td][td]Whether to predict the day of the next full moon, shown when hovering over the moon icon. Defaults to [i]Yes[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Flip Moon[/h1][/td][td]Whether to flip the moon phase icon to show it like it is in the Southern Hemisphere, instead of the default Northern Hemisphere. Defaults to [i]No[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Season Clock[/h1][/td][td][i]Clock[/i], the default, shows a full clock of the seasons. [i]Compact[/i] shows a smaller badge with the season and day count, while [i]Micro[/i] shows an even smaller badge. [i]No[/i] disables the season clock entirely.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Naughtiness[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the naughtiness of the player. Doesn't work in Don't Starve Together (unless [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2189004162]Insight[/url] is installed), as  naughtiness is not available to clients. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Log Meter[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the log meter for Woodie when he is human. Only relevant to singleplayer, as Don't Starve Together always shows the log meter already. Defaults to [i]Always[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Cave Clock[/h1][/td][td]Whether to always show the clock in the caves. Only relevant to singleplayer Reign of Giants, as the data is not available in vanilla and the clock shows in Don't Starve Together. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Stat Numbers[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the sanity, hunger, and health numbers without having to mouse over the badges. Defaults to [i]Always[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Max Text[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the "Max:" text when hovering over the sanity, hunger, and health badges to see their maximum values. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Clock Text[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show text on the Clock and Season Clock. Defaults to [i]Show[/i]. If set to [i]Hide[/i], text will only be shown when mousing over or opening the Controller Inventory.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]HUD Scale[/h1][/td][td]Lets you adjust the size of the badges and clocks independently of the game's HUD scale. Defaults to [i]1[/i].[/td][/tr]
[/table]

items.title: Nine Equipment Slots
items.description:
Freely choose between 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, or 9 equipment slots.
By enabling additional expanded slots, you can have up to 63 equipment slots, with all supported modded equipment effects working at the same time.
Adds Right-Hand, Clothing, Armor, Amulet, Hat, and Crown slots.

[h1]If Nine Equipment Slots helps you, please consider leaving a 👍. It helps more players find the mod in the Workshop.[/h1]

[h1]Right-Hand Slot[/h1]
[h1]Can equip anything usable in the left hand, and right-hand tools are compatible with ActionQueue.[/h1]
The right-hand slot supports all normal left-hand actions, including mining, digging, chopping, and more, without conflicts.
Normal right-click actions prioritize the left-hand item.
If the left hand has no available right-click function, the right-hand item is used automatically.
If both hands have right-click functions, normal right-click uses the left hand, while the Right-Hand Action key uses the right hand.
The default Right-Hand Action key is B and can be changed in the configuration menu.

[h1]Three Attack Modes[/h1]
Vanilla Single-Hand: Always attacks with the left-hand weapon.
Alternating Hands: First attack uses the left hand, second uses the right, then alternates continuously.
Dual-Hand Strike: A single attack separately applies the damage of both left- and right-hand weapons.
The default attack-mode switch key is V and can be changed in the configuration menu.

[h1]Expanded Equipment Slots[/h1]
Note: Modded equipment must be placed in expanded equipment slots for its effects to work correctly.
Do not disable an expanded slot while equipment is still inside it. Drop the equipment on the ground first.

Helmet, Hat, Armor, Clothing, and Amulet categories can each gain additional equipment slots.
Right-click the corresponding equipment area to expand or collapse it.
The configuration menu allows 1–10 expanded slots, with 3 enabled by default. Equipment placed inside works normally.

When selecting 20 slots, each category displays 20 slots, for 100 displayed slots in total. DST supports at most 63 real equipment slots, so slots beyond that limit are display-only.
Multiple items of the same type can work at the same time, such as multiple amulets, armor pieces, or hats.
Brightshade, Void, and similar set equipment placed in expanded slots still counts toward set bonuses.

Modded equipment is automatically supported where possible. If an item cannot be identified, it keeps its original slot instead of being forcibly classified and causing crashes.
Each added equipment category can be disabled independently. When disabled, equipped items are safely moved into the backpack, inventory, or dropped on the ground. Disabling all added categories restores the vanilla 3-slot equipment system.

[h1]Possible Medal Mod Issue[/h1]
In the Medal Mod configuration, please do not enable the edge-aligned display option. It may prevent medals with equipment slots from opening.
This is an issue with the Medal Mod itself and is unrelated to Nine Equipment Slots.

[h1]Important[/h1]
DST allows a maximum of 64 equipment slots. If another mod also adds equipment slots, reduce the number of expanded slots accordingly.
Do not enable this mod together with other multi-equipment-slot mods.
No save-corruption issues. Compatible with server utility mods such as Insight and Show Me.
All released versions are stable and safe to use.

[h1]Character Invisibility Issue[/h1]
If you disable Nine Equipment Slots, please restart the game. Restarting reloads the animation resources.
Because this mod adds right-hand animations, disabling it removes those animation resources. If the game still tries to reference them, the character model may become invisible.
Restarting the game reloads the animation resources and fixes the issue.
This is caused by DST's animation lookup system and cannot be changed by the mod.

If you encounter a problem, it is very likely unrelated to this mod. Please join the group and submit the crash log.
Animation overlap and occasional UI disappearance are known limitations inherited from the base game. They cannot be completely fixed, but do not affect equipment functionality.

[h1]Bug Reports | Mod Compatibility | Suggestions — QQ Group: 1106357973[/h1]
Your suggestions are a major help in improving this mod.
Thank you to every player who uses this Mod.

If you encounter any problems, bugs, or have new suggestions, feel free to leave a comment or join the group. I will reply as soon as possible.
I will try to read every piece of feedback and continue fixing problems and improving features.

This Mod is not a one-time project. It continues to improve through player feedback.
If this Mod improves your gameplay experience, please consider leaving a free Like.
Your support and feedback are the biggest motivation for me to continue maintaining and updating this Mod!

Thank you to everyone who spends time testing, reporting issues, and supporting the Mod.
Have fun!

This Mod supports Chinese, English, and Russian, and automatically switches based on the client's language.

[h1]The Most Comprehensive R-Key Sorting Mod[/h1]
Works like Minecraft-style R-key sorting. Instantly organizes your inventory and equipment slots without causing item-order problems when sorting again.

Includes 90 additional features:

items.name: 钠优化DSTSodium
items.title: Sodium
items.description:
DST Sodium improves frame-time stability in large worlds and long-running saves while preserving vanilla gameplay and final results wherever possible.

Inspired by Minecraft Sodium's approach to reducing unnecessary background work and spreading concentrated workloads across multiple frames.

Due to the limitations of DST's Lua API, this mod cannot replace the renderer or rewrite the game engine. It focuses on background timers and workload spikes that can be adjusted safely.

For the complete optimization, keeping all options enabled is recommended.

[b]Main Features[/b]

[b]Area Unloading Optimization[/b]
When an area leaves the active range, eligible plant-growth and production-building timers are paused. The elapsed time is compensated when the area becomes active again, preserving growth speed and production results.

[b]Base Loading Optimization[/b]
When entering an area containing many buildings and plants, timer-restoration work managed by this mod is distributed across multiple frames. A per-frame processing limit helps reduce sudden workload spikes.

Entity visuals, interaction and collision remain immediately available and are not delayed by the restoration queue.

[b]Unchanged Vanilla Content[/b]

[list]
[*]No changes to TUNING or vanilla balance values
[*]No changes to growth time, production output or production requirements
[*]No changes to chest contents, item stacks or save data
[*]No changes to cooking recipes, spoilage or fuel consumption
[*]No entities are removed, hidden or merged
[/list]

Performance improvements depend on save size, installed mods and hardware.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

This is a server-side mod. Other players do not need to install it.

Unofficial project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CaffeineMC or the Minecraft Sodium project.

items.title: Automatic Health Adjust
items.description:
This mod automatically adjusts the health of mobs depending on the number of active players, everytime a player joins or leaves.

Default is DS values for 1 player, and DST values for 6 players. 
(for 2,3,4,5 players , health will be between those values of course)
And in case for some reason you have more than 6 players, it will be higher than DST values!

Has setting to set min/max value for the number of players the mod should calculate with:
So if you are playing with 4+ players, but want max health values for 3, then you can set max to 3.
Or if you play with 2+ players, but want at least health values for 4 players, you can set min to 4.
Or set it both to 6 if you always want to play with values for 6 players.
By default it is disabled.

Cave and Overworld are separated. 
So if one player is in cave and one in Overworld, both worlds will have health values for 1 player.

More Customization:
in the customsettings.lua you can define your own health function!

Special case for crabking(-claws):
If a player joins/leaves during a fight against crab king, his health wont change. If you want to update his health according to new number of players, you have to leave and activate him again.

items.name: 物品信息
items.title: Item Info
items.description:
[b]This is a CLIENT mod. Can be used on any server![/b]

Inspired by the popular mods Display Food Values & Detailed Tooltips, I bring you Item Info.

[h1]What this mod does[/h1]
It displays items' values when hovering over them (hunger, sanity, health, spoilage, insulation [winter/summer], light remaining time, waterproof %, sanity gain/min, uses left, damage and armor including planar) via little icons and a value.


Additionally, it can display your equipped items on a panel on the right (configurable), so that you always know your spear's uses, your armor's hp left, or when your torch is going to run out of fuel.

[h1]Configuration Options[/h1]
The default config is just fine, but if you wanna tweak it, here it is:

    Info scale: Sets the tooltip's info scale.
    Time format: Change between hours:minutes:seconds and in-game days.
    Perish info: Set if you only want to see spoilage time, stale time and then spoilage time, or both.
    Show info hands/body/head: If you want to see your equipped items' info.
    Equipped Scale: Set the equipped item's scale, if you think they're too big or too small.
    Show prefab name: If you want to know your items' debug spawn name.
    Show background: If you wanna see a huge, interface-blocking background behind your equipped items.
    Margin bottom/right: To position the equipped item info.


[h1]How to install[/h1]
Just subscribe to the mod. That's it. This mod displays info in a different way to all others, so no need to replace fonts nor anything like that.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
Like other mods, this mod calculates values based on the item's current percent and the base item max values, so the following values might not be 100% exact: perish time, stale time, fuel time, clothes remaining time, uses left, hambat damage.

Controller is supported as of version 0.2

[h1]Current issues[/h1]
There's a bug related to modcomponentactions which only happens on modded servers triggered by the way this mod spawns a base item to check its stats. It has been fixed for a while but if you run into this let me know.
New characters after Wortox aren't fully supported yet (foods they won't eat, food bonuses, damage bonuses, etc). I might make some internal changes to add support for them & modded ones someday™


[h1]Latest changes[/h1]
Fixed crash when hovering over merm tools and upgraded merm tools.
Updated info to show planar damage/armor.
Updated spoilage calc to support Polar Bearger Bin.
Updated Wolfgang damage to support his mighty meter.


If you find a bug, have a suggestion or just like this mod, feel free to leave a comment.
If the mod ever breaks please add me as a friend and nag me every day till I fix it.

Stats increase with level

Experience points (exp) to level up

The higher the character level, the easier it is to obtain more items when gathering

Summoned pets will not be hungry, and you will never hear the pet's hungry howl

Capacity of 14 slots
Warmth equals that of a Horned Hat (240), rain resistance 20%

A versatile tool
Equip and right-click to open
Insert different tools to learn different functions and efficiencies
